scored_features.gate_reasoning: G1: TRUE — 'iage' (age) appears in trial_measured_features so the feature was recorded. G2: FALSE — the hypothesis offers only an epidemiologic claim (younger = fewer comorbidities/higher chance of survival) and does not name any concrete biological steps (receptor, enzyme, PK/PD change) explaining why TXA would act differently; G3..G5 FALSE by cascade. G3: FALSE — because no specific drug–host interaction (PK/PD or pathophysiologic mechanism) is proposed beyond baseline-risk differences, this is consistent with an absolute-risk amplifier, not a true effect-modifier. G4: FALSE — no specific literature support for a mechanistic age × TXA interaction is cited; speculative only. G5: FALSE — the subgroup (age < 40) is simple but the hypothesis does not provide a mechanistic guide to change treatment, so it is not clinically actionable as a mechanistic modifier.
scored_features.justification: Decisive failure at G2: the claim is epidemiologic (younger patients do better) without a named biological mechanism linking age to differential TXA action, so later gates fail.
